title: forced crouch/crawl under a low ceiling (Шаг 15 п.5)
notes: Static geometry, identical procedure on both targets: a 5-long roof strip at y=202 (z -58..-54) plus one isolated block at y=202 over the probe cell (z -46). A stands in the open (z -48), is teleported under the isolated block (head cell full), back to the open, walks forward (yaw 180, -z) under the roof strip, holds sneak, and walks back out. y=201 is standing feet level; a stone roof leaves 1.0 block of clearance, a top slab 1.5. Vanilla additionally performs the literal hypothesis probe: while A stands in the open, /setblock places the case block at y=202 over the open cell, then removes it (block-above-dynamic); ours cannot place blocks at runtime, so that phase runs on vanilla only. bbHeight/bbWidth are the client's own measured hitbox. The geometry is written to the dev file (s11) for our server or applied with /fill on vanilla.
